text:
sasha: quick sync - we need a safe way to avoid deleting on-prem artifacts when nodes are offline for unknown periods. proposals?

jordan: signature expiry is the crux. rotating manifests frequently will break nodes that are offline for days/weeks.

maya: can we add a non-secret lease entry in manifests that indicates "keep until"? operator-signed, no per-node secret.

kevin: lease + retention: default lease 30d, keep last 3 manifests for 21d. also store deltas to avoid full copy retention.

sasha: tradeoffs: extra state, operator tooling, and KMS rotation. but avoids re-signing every reconnect.

jordan: agents must tolerate clock skew. use 24h leeway when validating lease timestamps. warn instead of hard-fail.

maya: fallback mode: if verification fails, agent serves local artifacts and reports degraded flag; do not auto-delete local bundles.

kevin: operator UX: CLI to list/renew leases and a dry-run planner to show which nodes are impacted before rotation.

sasha: metrics to add: expired_leases, gc_candidates, offline_staleness_days, p95_reconcile_time. hook these into console alerts.

jordan: migration: v1 manifests are unchanged; v2 adds lease header. old agents ignore lease fields. controller publishes both for a grace period.

maya: edge-case: multiyear offline nodes require manual reseed. provide an offline verifier tool that helps operators create a signed reseed delta.

kevin: short impl sketch: manifest history service + lease index, GC controller, CLI + dry-run API, agent acceptance rules.

sasha: agree. I'll draft RFC with manifest schema, default numbers, and runbook. ping when ready for review.
